sections.title: Announcement bar
sections.job: Communicate one time-sensitive update without hijacking the visit
variants: status strip with optional countdown only if accurate
sections.behavior: Dismissal remembered locally where lawful; entire message readable; one real link
sections.motion: Single slide-in on initial load or discreet status crossfade
sections.reject: Fake scarcity countdown; looping marquee; banner covering nav
sections.states: dismissed; expired; multi-line localized text
sections.verify: Can keyboard-dismiss; banner does not shift focus or cover CTA

sections.title: Header and navigation
sections.job: Help users reach the right page without guessing
sections.behavior: Semantic real links; responsive disclosure; Escape returns focus; sticky only where useful
sections.motion: Indicator glide between real active links; controlled mobile drawer transition
sections.reject: Magnetic links that dodge clicks; hovering-only menus; endless glass overlays
sections.states: closed; open; keyboard; nested nav; signed in/out
sections.verify: Keyboard and screen reader paths; mobile menu at 360px; Back navigation

sections.title: Hero section
sections.job: Say what this product does, for whom, and why this specific product exists
sections.behavior: Specific headline and honest primary action; real proof; meaningful visual
sections.motion: One authored entrance sequence OR user-triggered product reveal
sections.reject: Purple blob; generic three-card cloud; endless particles; fake numbers
sections.states: mobile wrapping; missing image; slow load; reduced motion
sections.verify: First-glance clarity; CTA test; 360/390/1440 captures

sections.title: Product showcase
sections.job: Show an actual capability or object in useful context
sections.behavior: Hotspots keyboard-usable; samples identify mock content; media licensing known
sections.motion: Hotspot reveal on activation; small shared-layout tab transition
sections.reject: Floating UI screenshots with unreadable 10px text; invented prototype data
sections.states: tabs; zoom; failed media; touch; long labels
sections.verify: Image fidelity; tab order; small-device detail readability

sections.title: Features section
sections.job: Explain benefits with concrete capabilities not generic marketing
sections.behavior: Each feature has what/why/outcome/proof; feature media real
sections.motion: Focused reveal of selected feature; gentle drawing of an actual diagram
sections.reject: Identical rounded 3 cards; vague 'AI-powered' fluff; icons for decoration
sections.states: long copy; missing illustration; keyboard feature switch
sections.verify: Benefit understood without motion; interaction works with keyboard

sections.title: Benefit storytelling
sections.job: Make user stakes and outcomes emotionally legible
sections.behavior: Before and after must be verifiable or illustrative-label; preserve actual testimonials only
sections.motion: Scroll-linked chapter transition with static equivalent
sections.reject: Stock handshakes; manipulated before-and-after; full-screen scrolljacking
sections.states: reduced motion; narrow viewport; content expanded
sections.verify: Reading continuity without animation; no forced scrolling

sections.title: How it works
sections.job: Explain sequence in fewer steps with no hidden prerequisites
sections.behavior: Steps retain numbering and visible prerequisites; actual paths real
sections.motion: SVG path progress on scroll OR step-change only after tap
sections.reject: Three steps with meaningless icons; autoplay maze; fabricated setup simplicity
sections.states: branching; current step; no JS; touch
sections.verify: Can explain in one minute; all steps readable statically

sections.title: Interactive demo
sections.job: Let visitors test real product behavior safely
sections.behavior: Sandbox must not hit destructive production endpoints; clear outputs/errors
sections.motion: State-driven transition after user action, no animation hiding results
sections.reject: Fake input fields; prerecorded 'live' response without label
sections.states: loading; success; invalid; failure; reset
sections.verify: Network disabled and invalid input path tested

sections.title: Logos and trust proof
sections.job: Convey credible evidence only where it exists
sections.behavior: Permission and provenance for client marks; citations to real results
sections.motion: Simple disclosure expansion for evidence detail
sections.reject: Imaginary Fortune 500 logos; infinite logo crawl; uncited star counts
sections.states: zero testimonials; stale badges; broken logos
sections.verify: Trace each displayed claim to source; screen reader labels

sections.title: Metrics and outcomes
sections.job: Explain meaningful quantities with traceability
sections.behavior: Label date/source, denominator, units, methodology; no invented values
sections.motion: One-time datum highlight after render, never fake count-up
sections.reject: Count-up from 0 without reason; meaningless '99.9%'
sections.states: no data; incomplete data; stale metrics; error
sections.verify: Values match dataset; charts readable without animation

sections.title: Testimonials
sections.job: Preserve real voice while making it easy to judge relevance
sections.behavior: Name/company only with consent; citation; optional anonymous labeled case
sections.motion: Subtle optional carousel on button, no timer
sections.reject: Synthetic headshots; generated praises; uncontrollable auto-slider
sections.states: none available; long quote; mobile carousel
sections.verify: Authenticity checked; content reachable without swipe

sections.title: Case study
sections.job: Prove a meaningful result from problem to change to measured outcome
sections.behavior: Problem; intervention; evidence; limitations; action to read full study
sections.motion: Chapter index active state; annotated screenshot compare
sections.reject: Photoshopped proof; fake growth charts; ornamental graphs
sections.states: missing metrics; citation unavailable; narrow content
sections.verify: Trace all claims; compare with/without motion

sections.title: Comparison table
sections.job: Help visitor choose fairly between realistic options
sections.behavior: Accurate claims with dates; row/column labels; truthful unknowns
sections.motion: Highlight currently focused row/column, not an entire fireworks show
sections.reject: Biased fake competitor scores; hidden disqualifiers
sections.states: very wide tables; unknown value; updated price
sections.verify: Keyboard reading order; responsive scroll cue; truthful alternatives

sections.title: Pricing section
sections.job: Make cost, scope and consequences unmistakable
sections.behavior: Real currency/billing cadence, tax notes, cancel/refund boundaries, live working checkout link
sections.motion: User-triggered monthly/yearly numeric transition with semantic announcement
sections.reject: Unclear dark-pattern default; animated fake discount; mystery add-ons
sections.states: free tier; currencies; unavailable checkout; error
sections.verify: Total and cadence correct; keyboard toggle; no hidden cost

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
sections.job: Remove concrete friction and objections before signup
sections.behavior: Native details or accessible disclosure; direct deep links; source-aware answers
sections.motion: Quick height/opacity expansion only if non-disorienting; reduced fallback
sections.reject: Twenty canned generic questions; auto-opening every item
sections.states: nested answer links; no result; very long text
sections.verify: Keyboard disclosure and focus; no clipped content

sections.title: Integrations
sections.job: Explain exactly what connects, permissions and capabilities
sections.behavior: Only real supported providers; states and setup requirements accurate
sections.motion: Connection line highlights after selection not constant ambient motion
sections.reject: Floating random logos; claimed integrations that are mockups
sections.states: disconnected; auth failed; revoked; coming soon
sections.verify: Real documentation destinations; states accurately named

sections.title: Use cases
sections.job: Help distinct audiences recognize their jobs
sections.behavior: Each job carries real outcome, constraints and user language
sections.motion: Selected persona panel transition activated by click
sections.reject: Generic 'teams of all sizes' feature cards; stereotyping roles
sections.states: empty category; long localization; touch
sections.verify: User identifies entry route and relevant example in <30sec

sections.title: Visual gallery
sections.job: Show authored media without overwhelming browse and download
sections.behavior: Real licensed assets and captions; focus-safe lightbox; alt text
sections.motion: Purposeful crossfade of chosen work or user-controlled carousel
sections.reject: Endless autoplay slideshow; 3D spin obscuring media
sections.states: failed image; keyboard lightbox; portrait/landscape
sections.verify: Source rights; ESC focus restore; bandwidth optimization

sections.title: Portfolio project section
sections.job: Demonstrate skills with a distinctive story of decisions
sections.behavior: Role contribution, real screenshots, constraints, result and source
sections.motion: Project panel reveal with motion driven by explicit selection
sections.reject: Identical animated 'card hover' grid; fake agency clients
sections.states: no public results; long titles; sensitive work
sections.verify: Viewer understands creator role; accessible keyboard navigation

sections.title: Editorial blog and feed
sections.job: Make long-form knowledge easy to scan and enter
sections.behavior: Dates/authors/categories meaningful; honest summaries; headings semantic
sections.motion: Subtle underline follow or article preview after focus
sections.reject: Generic cards with fake reading times; endless scroll no footer
sections.states: pagination; empty topic; long title; search
sections.verify: Scanability at 360px; article links valid

sections.title: Storefront catalog
sections.job: Enable filtering and comparing real merchandise
sections.behavior: Prices/inventory real; filters reflect availability; fast thumbnail loading
sections.motion: Filter reflow with stable layout and focus, no flying tiles
sections.reject: Fake sold-out urgency; hover-only add; orphaned inventory
sections.states: empty filters; out of stock; price changes
sections.verify: Cart state correct; back from product retains filter

sections.title: Commerce product detail
sections.job: Answer fit, delivery, variants and trust questions
sections.behavior: Variant pricing/stock/deadlines source-backed; accessible gallery
sections.motion: User-triggered variant morph with focus retained
sections.reject: Huge video masking buy button; false countdown or reviews
sections.states: variant out of stock; missing image; long specs
sections.verify: Add to cart exact variant; zoom; returns; touch

sections.title: Newsletter capture
sections.job: Earn trust and opt-in with clear value and frequency
sections.behavior: Real consent, privacy copy, validation, success and unsubscribe clarity
sections.motion: Submit button progress to explicit confirmation
sections.reject: Fake 'joined by 100k' metric; email wall for unrelated content
sections.states: invalid address; double submit; API failure
sections.verify: Test validation and announcements; no fake saved state

sections.title: Contact section
sections.job: Provide a real path to reach the right person
sections.behavior: Form labels, anti-spam, privacy, successful send only after server confirms
sections.motion: Field validation feedback after interaction; success without confetti
sections.reject: Generic fake form that never sends; too many required fields
sections.states: offline; failed submit; missing consent
sections.verify: Keyboard field order; realistic success/error paths

sections.title: Final call to action
sections.job: Invite one next step with strong product-specific reasoning
sections.behavior: Specific action, real destination, cost/commitment truthful
sections.motion: One soft emphasis tied to focus/hover; no pulse loop
sections.reject: Generic 'Ready to revolutionize' or another irrelevant gradient card
sections.states: disabled action; logged in user; mobile layout
sections.verify: Primary link works; zero ambiguous copy

sections.title: Footer and global utility
sections.job: Make site closure, policy and secondary navigation reliable
sections.behavior: Truthful policy links, year, contact and copyright; accessible sitemap
sections.motion: No motion required; optional hover underline only
sections.reject: Huge decorative particles; broken policy or phantom socials
sections.states: very long links; small touch screens
sections.verify: All links verified; contrast at bottom; reading order

sections.title: Site search and filtering
sections.job: Get users to information quickly without visual clutter
sections.behavior: Query/relevance, zero state, keyboard shortcuts and loading credible
sections.motion: Result appearance only after actual update; no infinite shimmer
sections.reject: Fake AI answers; nonfunctional Cmd K; result cards clipping
sections.states: zero; typo; slow; offline; no permissions
sections.verify: Enter/Escape/Arrow keys; real results, reset controls

sections.title: Website checkout
sections.job: Make the transaction secure, transparent and reversible
sections.behavior: Exact totals, payment confirmation, failure recovery, privacy; no fake lock badges
sections.motion: Step changes via small directional transition; totals announced
sections.reject: Fake security logos; animations hiding fees; disabled cancel
sections.states: decline; expired payment; retry; 3DS; success
sections.verify: End-to-end test payment in sandbox only; prevent double pay

sections.title: 404 and empty route
sections.job: Help users recover from a bad URL instead of dead-ending
sections.behavior: Real navigation links; route-safe redirect; no pretend magic assistant
sections.motion: Small original branded illustration reacting to user action
sections.reject: Huge 3D monster covering search; taunting copy
sections.states: offline; unmatched route; search blank
sections.verify: Back/home and search keyboard-tested

sections.title: Documentation and technical guides
sections.job: Get developer to a correct implementation quickly
sections.behavior: Correct commands; version/versioning, copy; permanent deep links
sections.motion: Code tab highlight on selection; not auto-typing terminal
sections.reject: Decorative IDE screenshots; fabricated run outputs
sections.states: syntax fallback; long code; mobile sticky nav
sections.verify: Copy code equality; keyboard tab switching; narrow viewport

sections.title: Event and schedule section
sections.job: Communicate accurate times, locations and attendance path
sections.behavior: Timezone, date, availability and organizer details source-backed
sections.motion: Agenda phase highlight on selected day, not running clock
sections.reject: Fake countdown; event photos with fabricated speakers
sections.states: past event; timezone swap; full event
sections.verify: Dates converted correctly and registration link works

sections.title: Roadmap or history
sections.job: Explain milestones without claiming future certainty
sections.behavior: Distinguish done/in progress/planned and source of claims
sections.motion: Progress line follows focus or scrolling with reduced-motion static list
sections.reject: Roadmap presented as guaranteed; long paralax; impossible dates
sections.states: empty history; delayed milestone; many records
sections.verify: A11y chronological order; unchanged semantics without JavaScript
